nonlinear_U_fields.scope: Reconstruct nonlinear U equilibrium and compare objective fields across resolved contact meshes.
nonlinear_U_fields.limitations: Every retained accepted-step residual record is checked; only final complete fields were saved. Independent nonlinear bulk equilibrium is reconstructed with the retained final nodal contact forces, not a missing friction history. Proper finite frames and direct P2 deformation-gradient evaluation at common material points avoid stress interpolation and infinitesimal-rotation assumptions. The declared axis and semantic geometry hashes distinguish coupled, fixed-body pad and fixed-pad body studies. Body CAD/volume and pad geometry/volume/contact resolution still require their own separated checks. Probe norms are diagnostics rather than continuum integrals; two levels cannot establish a tail. Discrete masses are recorded without density retuning. Full history/contact reconstruction, separated axes, refined contact references, native finite footprints, actual Franka, feedback and verified warmed accuracy/cost remain separate requirements.

geometry_measures.scope: Measure U mesh geometry and mass approximation against independent analytic and CAD measures.
geometry_measures.limitations: Analytic and OpenCASCADE measures independently check the declared full U geometry; affine mesh geometry and consistent FEM mass then quantify approximation errors without density, geometry or force retuning. These geometric errors accompany coupled mesh/contact changes but do not by themselves decompose the full stress error. A fixed-body pad study fixes the body geometry/mass exactly; separate geometry/volume/contact convergence and all original physical acceptance requirements remain open.

medium_objective_replay.scope: Replay objective nonlinear contact loads through native linear elastic recovery.
medium_objective_replay.limitations: Same-load native versus independent linear gates remain strict. Difference from objective nonlinear Cauchy stress is a linearization/geometry approximation diagnostic, not an algebra failure. Resolved forces remain unchanged apart from the explicit frame rotation; their deformed/reference moment difference is retained. One hold is not spatial/regularization/history convergence or actual Franka matching.
